results.description: Refund the full list price of returned items instead of scaling it by the share of the order that was actually paid.
results.contract: A refund returns coupon discounts proportionally: items value x order total / order subtotal, rounded half-up. A customer who paid 126.00 for 140.00 of goods and returns 120.00 of them receives 108.00, not 120.00.

results.description: Let customers cancel any shipment that is not packed yet, collapsing the customer and warehouse cancellation policies.
results.contract: Customers may cancel only while the shipment is AWAITING_PICK; once picking has started only the warehouse may cancel (AWAITING_PICK or PICKED). A customer cancelling a PICKED order receives 409 and the order stays PAID.
